summary: Private resident car park of an apartment tower, right beside the pool.
reasons: Pool and gardens beside the bays

best_section.where: North-west bays of the small car park off the main road

drivers.seclusion: Riverview Gardens apartments touch the outline at 63 m and Southbank Apartments are 19 m away; the tower overlooks the whole lot.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot opening off the road with marked bays; room for a van, but it is a resident car park.
drivers.traffic: Main road with kerb parking 15 m to the north.
drivers.convention: Serves the apartment block; no sign of overnight stays by outsiders.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of the outline
Brisbane River 172 m away, ground about 8 m
sun_shade: Open asphalt; the tower shades it from the south and east in the afternoon.
